fields.title: Subset column
fields.description: The column that contains the subsets to search for.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: ID column
fields.description: The id of the set to search in.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Set column
fields.description: The column that contains sets to search in
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Append set column
fields.description: The matching set is appended if this option is ticked. A new row is created for each matching set.

fields.title: Maximum mismatches
fields.description:
The maximum number of allowed mismatches, e.g. 1 allows for one item of the subset to be missing in the
set. Default value is 0 where only sets match that contain all items of the subset.
